_doc: docs/structures.md. Built structures in the shore (tools/structures.py): fill (a polygon, walls on every edge not in `open`, a paved cap, optional pilings), wall (a polyline; top per vertex, foot on the low ground; apron: the strip drawn behind the coping, over the ground the height textures keep low there), ramp (top to toe centreline, width). Points [x, z, y]: level metres (x east, z south), y metres NAVD 88. Materials below name the façade shader tile and tint each surface takes. The editor overrides by id in authored.json `structures`.
frame: level metres, x east, z south; heights NAVD 88
source: OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL); USGS 3DEP lidar (Entwine, AWS; public domain); Matt (19 Oct) for what each one is
